comment.text: HOXB2 P335 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Papillary renal cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting HOXB2 residue P335 have been observed in lung adenocarcinoma, cutaneous melanoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.

comment.text: HOXB2 P335P is an allele annotation observed in Cancer Hotspots v1 at the P335 hotspot or indel region. This documents recurrence in the source cohorts; allele-specific function, tumor-specific significance, reference-sequence mapping, and clinical actionability require independent review.
